policy_note.String: VersionedProjectPolicy: select the already executable A Dash of Color program as a reward-only substitute for preset 1010, without claiming it belongs to the original Reward-type pool. The source-backed level-one count is one. Candidate identity, selection distribution and refresh are unavailable; no event-pool RNG or hidden NPC graph is invented. Its three existing policy choices grant 200 Fragments, two Curios or two Blessings through the shared acquisition pipeline. Alternatives are disabling the card or fabricating candidate weights; this bounded substitute preserves a real reward/finish/Leave boundary. Membership-parity confidence is unproven. Data admission and Ordinary/Cyclical sampled-card tests freeze the selected policy independently of the event's existing reward-selection policy.

replacement_condition.String: Replace the substitute identity/selection when current released Reward event graphs or reproducible observations prove the preset's candidate pool and distribution. Other levels, fixed Reward rooms, NPC presentation and original pool parity remain unimplemented; raw neighboring presets are not current-profile admission evidence.
